text:
DUNMARROW, 14 March 2031 (Meridian Brief) — The planned Dunmarrow canal tunnel will run 11 kilometres, after the project's final route was confirmed on Friday, according to people familiar with the matter.

The route is set out in the Dunmarrow Canal Tunnel Feasibility and Route Report (Report DWA-31/07), presented to the Harlow Basin Regional Council.

The tunnel is budgeted at 2.4 billion Verrian marks, with boring planned to take six years, the people said.

Marisol Treadgold, Chief Engineer of the Dunmarrow Waterways Authority, is leading the engineering work on the project, they added.

The confirmation of the final route clears the way for the next planning stage. The Dunmarrow Waterways Authority did not immediately respond to a request for further detail on the schedule.

Meridian Brief will update this report as more information becomes available.
